finding.claim: Join validation (password, checksums, mod, joinable) is ineffective: joinReturnError+return inside the WithReadLock closure only exits the closure, so the handler still adds the peer and returns success. Any logged-in user can join password-protected or locked lobbies and receive their lobby broadcasts.
finding.source: Any authenticated session (SessionMiddleware) posting POST /game/advertisement/join with a target advertisement id and a wrong/empty password or mismatched checksums (join.go:34-48, router/game.go:162).
finding.sink: advertisements.UnsafeNewPeer at join.go:85 adds the attacker as a peer; subsequent lobby broadcasts (e.g. MatchStartMessage in updateState.go:72-85, PlatformSessionUpdateMessage in updatePlatformLobbyID.go:65-73) are delivered to all peers.

existing lobby membership removed before validation (side effect even on rejected joins)
party check returns from handler correctly
WithReadLock closure begins
joinable/checksum/mod/password comparisons
joinReturnError writes an error JSON response
return exits only the closure, not Join
second WithWriteLock closure; ok still true
UnsafeNewPeer adds attacker as peer
success response written, appended after the error body

finding.guards_checked: SessionMiddleware (session required, sessionmiddleware.go:22-35); party check (join.go:65-68) works; user/advertisement existence checks. NOT effective: password, checksum, mod, joinable checks (join.go:70-78) because of the closure return. Only one such pattern in the advertisement package (grep). Dynamic verification not performed.

finding.claim: UpdateState performs no host or peer authorization: any authenticated user can set the state of any advertisement, including forcing a match start (broadcasting MatchStartMessage to all peers) or closing/hiding another user's lobby.
finding.source: Any authenticated session posting POST /game/advertisement/updateState with an arbitrary advertisementid and state (updateState.go:14-24; route game.go:192).
finding.sink: adv.UnsafeUpdateState(q.State) at updateState.go:41 (sets state, startTime, visible), then wss.SendOrStoreMessage MatchStartMessage to all peers at updateState.go:72-85.

SessionMiddleware wraps group; session existence only
Bind of advertisementid/state
lookup by attacker-supplied advertisement id
state changed with no check that caller is host or peer
broadcast to all peers when state==1

finding.guards_checked: SessionMiddleware (session must exist). The file has no reference to the session, the host id or peers before the state change (grep for sess/Session/GetUserId/HostId/Peers returned only the peer broadcast). Compare updatePlatformLobbyID.go:47 which does check peer membership. Dynamic verification not performed.

finding.claim: PlayFab login routes mint a session for any user with no credentials: LoginWithCustomID takes a numeric user id and LoginWithSteam accepts a hex SteamID that is only decoded, not verified. The game-login Authentication setting does not apply to PlayFab, so with authentication enabled an attacker can obtain a PlayFab session as any victim.
finding.source: Unauthenticated POST to PlayFab Client/LoginWithCustomID (CustomId = victim user id) or Client/LoginWithSteam (SteamTicket = victim SteamID hex).
finding.sink: sessions.CreateWithUserId / CreateWithSteamUserId (models/playfab/session.go:54-66) returns a token used as SessionTicket and EntityToken (LoginWithSteam.go:68-80) and then authorizes all PlayFab routes as sess.User(), e.g. CloudScript ExecuteFunction (ExecuteFunction.go:44-47) and GetUserData (GetUserData.go:12-15).

trace.note: LoginWithSteam/LoginWithCustomID in playAnonymousPaths; no auth
CustomId parsed as int32 only
session created for that user id
ParseSteamIDHex decodes hex with no signature/app-ticket verification (models/playfab/steamAppTicket.go:28-)
EntityToken/SessionTicket returned to caller
Authentication check applies only to game platform login, not PlayFab

finding.guards_checked: playAnonymousPaths allowlist (playfabapiMiddleware.go:15-20); Authentication mode (cmd/root.go:100-107, router/game.go:94) applies only to game login. Default Authentication is 'disabled' (cmd/root.go:330), so the issue matters only when required/cached/adaptive is set. Dynamic verification not performed.

finding.claim: Session IDs, cloudfiles signatures and PlayFab tokens come from a PCG generator seeded with NewPCG(seed, seed) where seed is wall-clock UnixNano at startup, giving about 64 bits of effective entropy. An attacker who knows the approximate start time and observes some output may predict or forge session and signature tokens. Confidence low to medium: the seed-search cost is an estimate that I did not test.
finding.source: Network attacker holding one legitimately issued session (own login) and an approximate server start time (window of roughly an hour).
finding.sink: Bearer session token checks (SessionMiddleware sessionMiddleware.go:23-35), cloudfiles signature check (cloudfiles.go:37), PlayFab session auth (playfabapiMiddleware.go:33-38).

trace.note: seed = UnixNano unless Deterministic
rand.NewPCG(seed, seed): state is 64 bits of seed duplicated
30-char session IDs drawn via rand.IntN from that generator
cloudfiles sig = SHA-256 of 32 generator bytes
PlayFab session/entity token from the same generator

finding.guards_checked: Session expiry (5 min) and existence checks; the sig is bound to the file key (cloudfiles.go:46). These limit how long a forged token stays valid, but do not stop prediction. No test of the search cost was run.
